title: Starting university
instructions: Defne üniversitedeki ilk haftasını anlatıyor. Duygularına ve yaşadıklarına dikkat et.

script.speaker: s
script.text: Last week was my first week at university.

script.speaker: s
script.text: I'm studying architecture in a city three hours from my home.

script.speaker: s
script.text: I live in a student flat with three other girls. They are all very friendly.

script.speaker: s
script.text: The lessons are difficult, and there is a lot of reading.

script.speaker: s
script.text: I miss my family, but I call them every evening.

questions.feedback: Bir öğrenci dairesinde üç kızla birlikte yaşıyor.
questions.evidence: I live in a student flat with three other girls.

questions.prompt: How often does she call her family?
